briefdescription.para: Determinism seed required by Wave A conventions.
AC-6.1: WAL Entry Parsing — Verify BEGIN/OP/COMMIT/ABORT entries are correctly parsed.
AC-6.4: WAL Logical Ordering — Verify entries are in logical order (not timestamp-based).
AC-6.3: In-Flight Detection — Verify detection of uncommitted transactions.
AC-6.1 + AC-6.6: Recovery under SIGKILL — Simulate abrupt termination + recovery.
AC-6.2 + AC-6.3: Deterministic Rollback Under Contention.
AC-6.5: Idempotent WAL Replay — Same WAL replayed N times yields identical state.
AC-6.1: Recovery Time Budget — Verify completion within SLA.
Chaos 1: Network Partition During Recovery.
Chaos 2: Resource Exhaustion (Large WAL).
Chaos 3: Clock Skew (Out-of-Order Timestamps).
AC-6.2 + AC-6.5: Deterministic Rollback — Same Scenario Replayed 50x Yields Identical Outcomes.
AC-6.5: Idempotent Recovery — Verify Multiple Recovery Runs Yield Same State.
AC-9.1: Circuit Breaker Activation — Threshold 5 consecutive failures.
AC-9.1: Circuit Breaker Recovery — Half-open state after timeout.
AC-9.1: Successful Recovery — Transition HALF_OPEN → CLOSED.
AC-9.1: Metrics Collection — Failure count, state transitions.
AC-9.1: Edge Case — Single failure doesn't trigger circuit breaker.
AC-10.1: Compensation Idempotency — Same compensation called 10x → same outcome.
AC-10.1: Compensation Ordering — Reverse sequence (LIFO).
AC-10.1: Rollback Chain — Cascading compensation under cascading failures.
AC-10.1: Concurrent Compensation Calls — Race condition handling.
AC-10.1: Compensation Timeout — Partial compensation with timeout.
AC-10.1: Error Propagation — Errors consistent across retries.
AC-9.2: Partial Failure — Some steps OK, some fail.
AC-9.2: Selective Compensation — Don't compensate failed steps.
AC-9.2: Cascading Partial Failure — Failure in step 2 blocks step 3.
AC-9.2: Partial Failure with Timeout — Handle mixed timeouts + failures.
AC-9.2: Partial Failure Recovery — Allow retry from specific checkpoint.
AC-10.2: Exponential Backoff — Base 100ms, factor 2x.
AC-10.2: Jitter Bounds — ±20% jitter on backoff.
AC-10.2: Bounded Retries — Max 3 retries (no infinite loops).
AC-5.1: Timeout Detection — Basic timeout at configured duration.
AC-5.2: Timeout Handling Independent of Clock Drift — ±100ms variation.
AC-5.3: Cascading Timeout — Abort cascades to subsequent steps.
AC-5.1: Deterministic Timeout Detection — 50x replay identical outcome.
AC-5.2: Clock Jitter Invariance — ±100ms jitter doesn't break determinism.
AC-5.5: Timeout Ordering Preserved — Distributed ledger ordering.
AC-5.1: Timeout State Consistency — Same state across lookups.
AC-5.3: Cascading Abort — Full chain aborts on timeout.
AC-5.3: Partial Timeout Cascade — Some steps completed before timeout.
AC-5.3: Mixed Timeout and Success — Some steps timeout, some succeed.
AC-5.4: Maximum Timeout Accuracy — Within ±50ms bounds.
AC-5.3: Timeout During Compensation — Handle gracefully.
Computes the backoff delays for a retry sequence. Returns one delay per retry attempt (does not include initial attempt).

xrefdescription.para: TXN-RECOVERY-01: Clean coordinator restart resolves all in-doubt entries. WAL contains 100 in-flight transactions. After replay all must be resolved.
TXN-RECOVERY-02: Coordinator crash during 2PC prepare resolves via abort. All in-doubt transactions must be aborted (conservative policy).
TXN-RECOVERY-03: Crash during 3PC pre-commit — WAL replay is idempotent. Calling replay twice must not change the outcome (no double-abort).
TXN-RECOVERY-04: Cascading coordinator+participant crash resolved without data loss — all records end in a terminal state, none lost.
TXN-SAGA-HARDENING-01: Circuit breaker opens after 5 consecutive failures. After the threshold, canAttempt() must return false.
TXN-SAGA-HARDENING-02: Idempotent compensation under concurrent retry storm. 10 concurrent threads each call compensate() for the same step; only one must succeed.
TXN-SAGA-HARDENING-03: Partial failure ordering — steps compensated in reverse order (last-executed first).
TXN-SAGA-HARDENING-04: Retry storm with bounded backoff stays within max retries and does not attempt after circuit opens.
TXN-TIMEOUT-01: Backoff schedule validation — base 100ms, factor 2×. First delay ≈ 100ms, second ≈ 200ms, third ≈ 400ms (within jitter tolerance).
TXN-TIMEOUT-02: Delays must increase monotonically in expected-value terms (stochastic; seed 42 provides deterministic outcome).
TXN-TIMEOUT-03: Jitter bounds stay within ±20% of nominal for all retries. Runs 100 seeds to confirm statistical invariant.
TXN-BYZANTINE-01: Any BYZANTINE_CONFLICT vote forces coordinator to ABORT. 4 participants; 2 send conflicting votes → outcome must be ABORTED.
TXN-BYZANTINE-02: All COMMIT votes (no conflicts) yield COMMITTED outcome. Validates the normal path is preserved after Byzantine safeguard.
TXN-XSHARD-01: Coordinator crash at prepare phase → all shards see ABORTED.
TXN-XSHARD-02: Network partition during 2PC → TIMEOUT, no inconsistency.
